attributes.digest: List output mode

attributes.digest: Multiplier
attributes.description: Sets a multiplier value. Theobject's value will be multiplied by this number before it is sent out the outlet. The default value is 1.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.digest: Orientation
attributes.description: Sets theobject to a horizontal or vertical data display.: (the default) sets the display dependent on the size of the slider - longest side of the rectangle that describes the slider sets the orientation.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.digest: Connect to Parameter
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Clicking on theobject and dragging sets the minimum and maximum values and sends them out the object's outlets (or left outlet in list mode). or setting attributes.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Sends out the minimum and maximum values of the currently displayed range.

messages.name: ft1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored as the maximum limit of the range displayed in color on the. A number that exceeds the limits of theitself will be limited to stay within the.The minimum and maximum values can also be set (and sent out) by dragging with the mouse across a range in the.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored as the maximum limit of the range displayed in color on the. A number that exceeds the limits of theitself will be limited to stay within the.The minimum and maximum values can also be set (and sent out) by dragging with the mouse across a range in the.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: The number sets the minimum limit of a range displayed as a colored region on the, and causes the minimum and maximum values of that range to be sent out. A number that exceeds the limits of theitself will be limited to stay within the.The minimum and maximum values can also be set (and sent out) by dragging with the mouse across a range in the.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In left inlet: The first two numbers in the list are used to set the minimum and maximum values of the displayed range, and are sent out.

messages.name: set
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by two numbers, sets the minimum and maximum values of the currently displayed range, without sending them out the outlets.

messages.name: setminmax
messages.description: The word, followed by two numbers, sets the low and high range values for theobject. Theattribute will automatically be set.
